title: Arbitrary ramified quotient coefficient maps and balanced derived reduction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding $i:E\to F$, valuation rings $A,B$, chosen uniformizers $t,v$, and $A_{E,n}=A/(t^n)$, $A_{F,a}=B/(v^a)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Fix $e\in\mathbf N$ with the ramification ideal equality $\operatorname{map}(A\to B,(t))=(v^e)$, and use its retained quotient map $A_{E,n}\to A_{F,en}$ and tensor-unit-normalized tensor-composition comparisons [def-pur-finite-compact-support-scalar-data]. For $n,a\in\mathbf N$ and $a\le en$, define $q_{n,a}:A_{E,n}\to A_{F,a}$ to be this retained quotient map followed by the canonical further quotient $A_{F,en}\to A_{F,a}$. For a scheme $W$ on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], define $(q_{n,a})_W$ by applying the constant-sheaf functor to this ring homomorphism, with the standard coefficient universe lift [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $R_E\to R_F$ be the canonical residue-normalized completed coefficient map [def-weil-completed-integral-scalar-data], with finite projections $\pi_{E,n},\pi_{F,a}$ [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. When $1\le n$ and $1\le a$, define the balanced derived reduction isomorphism
$$(-\otimes^L_{R_E}R_F)\otimes^L_{R_F}(A_{F,a})_W\simeq(-\otimes^L_{R_E}(A_{E,n})_W)\otimes^L_{(A_{E,n})_W}(A_{F,a})_W$$
using derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]: compose the tensor-composition isomorphism for $R_E\to R_F\to(A_{F,a})_W$, identified with $R_E\xrightarrow{\pi_{E,n}}(A_{E,n})_W\xrightarrow{(q_{n,a})_W}(A_{F,a})_W$, with the inverse tensor-composition isomorphism for the latter factorization. The coefficient and scheme carriers here have the same universe, as in these published declarations. The quotient-map definitions allow $n=0$ and $a=0$; only the balanced reduction uses positive exponents.

def compactSupportCoefficientBalancedReduction
    (e : ℕ) (he : PurCompactSupport.Ramification l E F i e)
    (n a : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (ha : 1 ≤ a) (han : a ≤ e * n) (W : Scheme.{u}) :
    pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i W) ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend (PurCompactSupport.projection l F a ha W) ≅
      pbcDerivedExtend (PurCompactSupport.projection l E n hn W) ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend
          (compactSupportCoefficientQuotientSheaf l E F i e he n a han W)
